map.圆筒 p=1 MPa、d=1000 mm、[σ]=140 MPa、焊接系数 φ=: For a cylinder with p=1 MPa, d=1000 mm, [σ]=140 MPa and weld efficiency φ=0.85: t=pd/(2[σ]φ)=1×1000/(2×140×0.85)=4.2 mm (then add the corrosion allowance).
